home.title: The site is coming soon.
home.subtitle: Followers, likes and views for your social media.
home.heroTitle: Grow your social accounts. Pay with <accent>Mobile Money</accent>.
home.heroText: Followers, likes and views for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Telegram and many other networks. Top up your balance, order, and follow every order in one place.
home.step1Text: An email address is enough. Sign-up takes a minute.
home.step2Text: Add any amount you like to your balance.
home.step3Text: Pick a service, paste your link, follow the progress.
home.feat1Text: Top up any amount you like, it is added to your balance.
home.feat2Text: Every order is deducted from your balance.
home.feat3Text: Each order has a status, from “pending” to “completed”.
home.feat4Text: The site, the services and support follow the language you choose.
home.faq1a: Create an account with an email address, top up your balance, then pick a service.
home.faq2a: With Mobile Money. You choose the amount and it is added to your balance.
home.faq3q: Which languages is the site available in?
home.faq3a: French and English. You can switch at any time in the header.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to place your first order?
home.servicesIntro: Pick your network, then the service. You see the price before you confirm.
